Run this from the project root:

```
node --test tests/cart.test.ts
```

I ran it: both cart tests pass, in about 75 ms.

Don't use `npm test -- tests/cart.test.ts`. The `test` script already includes the `tests/*.test.ts` glob, so npm adds your file to that list and runs every test anyway.

To run a single test by name, add a filter: `node --test --test-name-pattern="discount" tests/cart.test.ts`
